evidence: task.toml:5 `name = "turing/colderwater-playground-devtools"` equals turing/<logical dirname> (projects/colderwater-playground-devtools; the snapshot directory `task` is declared not an identity defect) and the hosted-run trial directories carry the same slug (colderwater-playground-devtools__Rc3y2sT). The slug has three hyphen tokens. task.toml:6 `description = "A browser code playground with a custom editor, formatting, multiple carets, isolated preview and saved revisions."` names this product and its real axes: each is asked for in instruction.md / instructions/overview.md ("formatting, selection, multiple carets and undo ... Keep the preview separate from the editing surface", "revision history") and graded (cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo, cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic, cw_preview_isolation, plus the save/revision criteria). task.toml:7 keywords keep the template's webdev/turing/full-stack and add custom-editor, javascript, html, formatting, code-playground, devtools, all true of the product (Express + better-sqlite3 server, JS and HTML modes, console panel). [metadata]: difficulty = "hard" (allowed value), difficulty_explanation describes the same editor/execution/revision-safe saving challenges, category = "programming", tags equal the template's, provenance = "Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task.", arena_slice = "custom-code-editor-formatting-preview-history". No CHANGE_ME placeholder remains, no other product's name appears anywhere in the task tree (a case-insensitive search for cold*water finds only Colderwater spellings), and the description/provenance quote no criterion counts that could go stale (actual counts 1+2 gate, 43 functional, 6 polish, 3 visual). tests/app_context.md:3 `Name: Colderwater playground`, solution package.json name `colderwater-playground-devtools`, server health service `colderwater-playground` and the app brand all agree. [task].version is absent, which the row allows. This row is static identity; no runtime measurement is required for it, and none is claimed. Notes (not defects): (1) the staged contract's comment on description lists "product, axes of difficulty, judge, dimension policy"; the description gives product and axes only, which also avoids stale counts; (2) the keyword and slug token `devtools` is the loosest descriptor (the product has a console and error line reporting, not a devtools suite) but it is consistent between slug, name and keywords; (3) QC run and repair folders outside the task are spelled `coldwater` while the task is `colderwater`; this is workspace bookkeeping and is not shipped; (4) the public brief never states the product name Colderwater, so a submission may brand itself differently; app_context's Name is a label for the judge only and no criterion read here requires that brand text.
